Aren’t all the old IBM machines using this?  Palmetto, Witherspoon, maybe Romulus?

I'm hoping to have someone from IBM reply if they want to change their perl script or if i should do it.


TBH i cannot follow the structure of each individual layer here and how they build
their packages and which part generates which configuration. Until now i did not even know that XML had any use in openbmc at all.


I'm hoping to get some feedback from the maintainers of each layer to confirm if it's been migrated correctly and if not, push me in the right direction.

@anoo@us.ibm.com can you help out here ? 😊
